name: zego
description: Applicant intake and review for hiring teams

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@zego/api & npm run dev --workspace=@zego/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@zego/api && npm run build --workspace=@zego/web
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && esbuild apps/api/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=api/_server.js --external:@prisma/client --external:express --external:cors --external:helmet --external:express-rate-limit --external:zod && npm run build --workspace=@zego/web
